name: Eco-Panels of Tennessee, Inc.
old_description: Along with having the lowest utility bills of all your neighbors, you'll have the safest, strongest, and most advanced built home of them all with Eco-Panel SIPs. Beware the waste of common construction and live smarter, forever.
about:
Eco-Panels of Tennessee, Inc. operates from Red Boiling Springs in Clay County, Tennessee, with its 35,000-square-foot manufacturing plant in nearby Hermitage Springs. The company was established in 2012 as a licensed franchise location for Eco-Panels, LLC of Mocksville, North Carolina, expanding to meet rising demand for structural insulated panels. It belongs to a family-owned group of businesses that has produced systems-built housing products and forestry commodities since the late 1970s, making it the largest non-governmental employer in the area.

The facility manufactures high-performance structural insulated panels (SIPs) for residential and commercial building applications. Using state-of-the-art technology, the plant produces panels in a wide variety of sizes, shapes, and configurations, achieving insulation values of R-26 in 4.5-inch panels and R-40 in 6.5-inch panels. The panels are described as two to three times stronger than conventional framing, with a foam core that contains no volatile organic compounds and does not melt at any temperature.

Eco-Panels serves homeowners, builders, and architects across the residential and commercial construction sectors, including timber-frame projects. Testimonials cite successful collaborations with individual homeowners such as Micah Mazanowski and Eric O’Donnell, as well as firms like 423 Dwell, LLC and licensed contractor Roger West. The company provides design assistance, installation guidance, and on-site training to support both professional crews and DIY builders.

The business was founded to offer a more economical, sustainable, and safer alternative to traditional construction. The company emphasizes lower utility, building, and labor costs with less waste, long-term energy savings, and reduced wood usage. As a franchise of the North Carolina–based Eco-Panels system, it leverages a proprietary panel technology marketed for its strength, environmental profile, and speed of assembly.

name: Ecotech Solar
old_description: Founded in 2004, Ecotech Solar began with a clear mission: to bring high-quality solar solutions to Northwest Washington through technical excellence and a genuine commitment to community. Dana Brandt, an electrical engineer with deep roots in renewable energy, started the company from a place of curiosity, care, and determination—values that still guide us today.
about:
Ecotech Solar was founded in 2004 in Bellingham, Washington, by electrical engineer Dana Brandt. The company began with a mission to bring high-quality solar solutions to Northwest Washington through technical excellence and community commitment, and it remains locally owned.

The firm provides design, installation, and long-term maintenance of residential, commercial, and community-scale solar and battery storage systems. Its in-house team handles custom design, permitting, installation, and ongoing support, with a NABCEP-certified senior electrician installations. To date, the company has completed over 2,200 installations across Whatcom, Skagit, Island, and surrounding counties.

Ecotech serves homeowners, businesses, nonprofits, tribal communities, libraries, schools, faith-based organizations, and public agencies throughout Northwest Washington. Projects range from single-family homes to community solar initiatives for civic entities.

The company differentiates itself through membership in the Amicus Solar Cooperative, which provides access to equipment and rigorous installation standards. Ecotech emphasizes long-term customer relationships, offering proactive maintenance and support for the life of each system.

name: Eden Oaks Designer Woodware
old_description: Founded in 2011 by Freddie Provenzano, Eden Oaks began as a small operation in a Colorado Springs storage unit and has grown into a 20,000-square-foot woodworking shop with a team of 25 full-time craftsmen and professionals.
about:
Founded in 2011 by Freddie Provenzano in Colorado Springs, Colorado, Eden Oaks began as a small operation run out of a storage unit. The company has since expanded to a 20,000-square-foot woodworking shop employing 25 full-time craftsmen and professionals.

Eden Oaks operates as a full-service design and build firm, providing custom and semi-custom cabinetry, architectural millwork, furniture, and casework. The in-house team handles design, material sourcing, fabrication, finishing, and installation, working with domestic hardwoods, reclaimed wood, metals, finishes, and epoxy resin. The facility produces a range of products including cabinets, countertops, islands, tables, bars, stair treads, doors, beams, accent walls, railings, mantels, and floating shelves.

The company serves both residential and commercial clients across Colorado and beyond. Residential work includes private homes, while commercial projects span restaurants, offices, hospitality spaces, and multi-unit developments. Eden Oaks collaborates directly with homeowners, interior designers, builders, and general contractors throughout the project lifecycle.

The firm emphasizes durability, precision, and thoughtful design, aiming to integrate the natural character of Colorado into each space. By managing the entire process from concept through installation, Eden Oaks seeks to ensure consistency and accountability, distinguishing itself through the use of eco-friendly materials and a curated showroom experience.

name: Elec-Tron
old_description: Elec-Tron of Wichita, Kansas has been proudly manufacturing power termination and electrical connectors in the USA since 1946.  Founded as Zimco Metal Products in April 1946, the company operated primarily as a contract manufacturer, producing miscellaneous metal stampings and assemblies. In 1954, the company changed its focus to producing primarily electrical switches, terminal blocks, and terminal boards. As Elec-Tron’s reputation for quality and timely delivery grew, the company began serving most major appliance manufacturers in the U.S. and abroad.
about:
Elec-Tron operates from Wichita, Kansas. Founded in April 1946 as Zimco Metal Products, a contract manufacturer of metal stampings and assemblies, the company shifted its focus in 1954 to electrical switches, terminal blocks, and terminal boards. In May 2022 it was acquired by North Park Group, a Chicago-based private family investment group that acquires family-owned U.S. manufacturers.

The company produces power termination and electrical connectors, including terminal blocks, terminal boards, fuse panels, mechanical aluminum lug connectors, and a range of terminals (quick-connect, screw, bifurcated soldering, and quick-connect tabs). Manufacturing is performed in-house, encompassing molding, stamping, assembly, and terminal identification printing. Annual output exceeds 10 million units shipped to over 300 customers. All components carry UL and CSA recognition.

Elec-Tron serves aerospace, appliance, automotive, electrical distribution, HVAC, commercial food and kitchen equipment, vending machines, industrial equipment, military, electric vehicle, and commercial equipment markets. Specific applications include furnaces, air conditioners, ovens, ranges, refrigerators, recreational vehicles, farm equipment, marine systems, material handling equipment, automatic door and gate openers, and motor controls.

The company was founded to provide reliable electrical connections; its engineers focus on delivering the right connection for the available space at competitive prices. Vertical integration and a broad catalog of standardized and custom configurations allow rapid fulfillment of diverse requirements.

name: Electric Equipment Enterprises
old_description: Since 1988, EEE has represented leading manufacturers and service providers of electrical distribution and transmission equipment ranging from 600 volts to 500 kV, serving the industrial, construction, and utility markets. Acting as an extension of the companies we represent, we provide front-end sales and technical support to Co-ops, Municipals, IOUs, distributors, electrical contractors, industrials, EPCs, power producers, and consulting engineers.
about:
Electric Equipment Enterprises (EEE) was founded in 1988 in Baton Rouge, Louisiana. The small business operates as a manufacturer's representative for electrical distribution and transmission equipment, covering voltages from 600 volts to 500 kV. The company began by partnering with manufacturers to serve industrial, construction, and utility markets across the southern United States.

EEE does not manufacture products itself; instead, it provides front‑end sales and technical support as an extension of the manufacturers it represents. Its team interprets project plans and specifications, then communicates requirements to suppliers for switchgear, transformers, bus systems, automation solutions, and specialized components. The firm maintains coverage across Louisiana, Mississippi, Arkansas, Tennessee, and Texas (Golden Triangle), leveraging decades of hands‑on experience to coordinate sourcing for projects of varying scale.

The company serves a broad customer base that includes cooperatives, municipal utilities, investor‑owned utilities, distributors, electrical contractors, industrial end‑users, engineering‑procurement‑construction firms, power producers, and consulting engineers. Its expertise spans utility‑scale transmission, industrial power systems, and commercial electrical infrastructure, with a focus on accurate specification and on‑time fulfillment.

EEE emphasizes its direct access to manufacturers, comprehensive technical guidance, and deep understanding of plans and specifications as key differentiators. The firm positions itself as a partner that combines industry expertise with a small‑business commitment to responsive service and reliable delivery.

name: Electric Wire & Cable Specialists (EWCS)
old_description: If you're looking for immediate shipment of the wire and cable that you need, you've come to the right place with Electric Wire and Cable Specialists. We've been in business since 1994 and it's our goal to get your products delivered in two to five business days, no matter how far away from our multiple fulfillment centers you are.
about:
Electric Wire & Cable Specialists (EWCS) has operated from Phoenix, Arizona since 1994. The company was founded as a wholesale electrical supply business focused on rapid order fulfillment.

EWCS stocks and distributes a broad range of wire and cable products including copper building wire (THHN, TFFN), welding cable (600‑volt extra‑flexible), portable cord (SOOW, SJOOW), marine‑grade UL‑approved primary wire and battery cable, security and alarm cable, fire‑alarm cable, solar‑panel cable, and Belden‑style electronic cable. The company maintains seven fulfillment centers across the United States and offers cut‑to‑length service for most items. Orders typically ship within 24 hours on business days, with free surface shipping and a stated delivery window of two to five business days. International shipments reach destinations in Mexico, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, India, and Siberia.

The supplier serves contractors and installers in construction, electrical, marine, welding, security, solar, and industrial automation markets. Typical customers include electrical contractors pulling building wire, marine technicians needing UL‑approved battery cable, welders requiring flexible 600‑volt cable, and security integrators sourcing plenum‑rated access‑control cable.

EWCS emphasizes speed and flexibility as its core differentiators: same‑day shipping from multiple service centers, no‑minimum cut lengths, free ground freight, and the ability to handle both small and large special orders. The company’s stated goal is to deliver the exact cable a project needs within a week of ordering.

Customers include 24/7 Onsite Cameras, CK Power, and Hubbell Power Systems.

The company emphasizes its in-house engineering, advanced manufacturing capabilities, and decades of experience as differentiators, positioning itself as a partner that helps OEMs solve complex electrical manufacturing challenges with engineering expertise, precision manufacturing, and dependable delivery.
